name: Inavolisib
drugClass: PI3K-alpha-selective inhibitor and mutant p110alpha degrader
mechanism: Highly selective p110alpha inhibitor that also promotes degradation of mutant p110alpha, with relative sparing of wild-type signalling; used with palbociclib and fulvestrant in PIK3CA-mutant endocrine-resistant disease.
monitoring: Fasting glucose and HbA1c before and during treatment
resistance: Expected to include PTEN loss and alternative PI3K pathway alterations; under study.
